verdict.rationale: PostHog AI is documented as an in-product analyst in a chat sidebar and inline UI entry points. It answers plain-English questions by querying data, building insights, writing SQL and finding replays, then explains what it found. Self-driving spots patterns and surfaces reports or suggested fixes in the inbox, and Replay Vision turns recordings into AI observations such as frustration scores, intent and session summaries. One hands-on user report describes the in-product LLM refusing a SQL-based cohort request and the UI slowing badly after a few prompts; that limits the experience but does not contradict the insights capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the AI-generated insights are good, and evidence that the reported cohort-creation limit and UI performance problems have been fixed.
